newsitem.title: UK: Br Gas says more to do on take-or-pay.
newsitem.headline: Br Gas says more to do on take-or-pay.

text.p: British Gas Plc said its agreement announced on Thursday with British Petroleum Plc was a good start to resolving its loss-making "take-or-pay' gas purchase contract obligations, but there was more to do.

"It's a good first start, but there is still a lot more to do," British Gas chairman Richard Giordano told Reuters. He said there could be "one or two" more deals announced in the near future with other gas suppliers.

British Gas struck a similar deal to the BP one with its internal gas production arm -- which sells gas to its supply business -- and said it would pay total compensation of 293 million stg to the two parties.
Through the termination of other contracts with BP, British Gas said it will cut its commitment to buy gas by approximately 2.8 billion therms, mainly over the next five years.
Prices will be reduced to market levels on a further 13.5 billion therms, phased in during the next few years.
